The '''Standing Brazier''' is a light source that can be placed on any surface, and must be built within the range of a [[Forge]].

==Usage==
The Standing Brazier has all the same functions as a [[Campfire]] and is a [[Player base|base]] structure.

Standing Braziers are fueled with [[Coal]]. With 1/5 fuel, a Standing Brazier will last for 5 hours and 33 minutes. At maximum capacity, a Standing Brazier should burn for 27 hours and 47 minutes. It can be used for cooking, however, it does not fit easily like a [[Campfire]] does.

The [[Fire Effect]] for the Standing Brazier extends for about 4–5 meters (Measured from the closest the player can stand without setting themselves on fire).

==Notes==
* Destroying the Standing Brazier with a [[Hammer]] will not yield back any [[Coal]] and will only return the 5 [[Bronze]] and 3 [[Fenris Claw]]s used for its construction. All Coal used as fuel and for the initial construction will <u>not</u> be dropped.
* Standing Braziers found in [[Frost Caves]] can be destroyed for Coal and sometimes Bronze.
* Standing Braziers stop working if exposed to rainy weather without a roof.

'''Tables''' are furniture. They can be used for placing items on top or as simple decorative objects.

== Common properties ==
Tables provide [[comfort]], but they do not stack with each other: only the highest-comfort table in a player's vicinity will provide comfort.

All tables have the following damage resistances:
* '''Weak''': [[Chop]]
* '''Neutral''': [[Blunt]], [[Slash]], [[Pickaxe]], [[Fire]], [[Frost]], [[Lightning]]
* '''Resistant''': [[Pierce]]
* '''Immune''': [[Poison]], [[Spirit]]

It increases [[Comfort]] by 2 when placed nearby. When placed outside the [[Mountain]] or Deep North biomes, the Snow Lantern loses 25% of its maximum durability (17.5 points) each time the game updates structure wear, so it breaks after four updates. == Fuel == The Snow Lantern uses [[Resin]] as fuel. It is placed with two units of fuel and holds up to six; each unit lasts 20,000 seconds, and it can be refilled. While it has fuel, it gives off a light orange light with a range of one meter. == Building == The Snow Lantern is built with the [[Hammer]] and requires a nearby [[Workbench]]. It costs: * {{Item link|Snowball|8}} {{BuildingNav}}

'''Sealskin Rug''' is a [[Deep North]] [[Rugs|rug]] made from [[Seal Pelt]]s. It increases [[Comfort]] by one when placed nearby; it belongs to the carpet comfort group, so it does not stack with other rugs or carpets.

== Building ==
The Sealskin Rug is found in the Deep North category of the [[Hammer]] and requires a nearby [[Workbench]] to build. It costs:
* {{Item link|Seal Pelt|4}}

It has 50 durability. It is resistant to pierce damage, weak to chop damage, and immune to poison and spirit damage. It is not damaged by rain.

== See also ==
* [[Rugs]]


== Trivia ==

* The Description of the rug notes that you are a horrible person for murdering such a innocent creature for a simple rug.
